material_findings.title: Signal cancellation scans an empty or previous run identity, not the active control
material_findings.mechanism: LAST_RUN_DIR is initialized empty and is assigned only after run_bounded returns, whereas TERM/INT calls finish from inside that active interval; finish scans only LAST_RUN_DIR and never resolves the active launcher's current run. [State and recovery](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L48-L64) [Finish/traps](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L88-L100) [Late assignment](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L134-L139)
material_findings.concrete_static_counterexample: Deliver driver TERM during the first control after its launcher has created OWNED_SID but before run_bounded returns: finish cancels the launcher, then skips session_state entirely because LAST_RUN_DIR is still empty, and exits with private_lease_free=unchecked and no current-session census; during control two the same path instead scans control one's directory. [Launcher OWNED_SID](../../s4-v5/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v5.sh#L149-L153) [Driver](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L88-L113) [Assignment](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L134-L139)
material_findings.consequence: The promised verification before every cancellation exit is absent on an ordinary supported TERM path; if cancellation produces a current quarantine holder or failed handoff, the terminal driver receipt cannot account for it, and the unresolved receipt initially records an empty/stale dir. [Driver receipt paths](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L60-L96) [Request claim](../../s4-v5/SLOT_REQUEST_V5.md#L33)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Associate the current launcher's run token/directory/SID with ACTIVE_PID before cancellable supervision, or resolve and validate that association inside finish before inspecting or signalling any session; distinguish no-spawn/unknown from verified empty.
material_findings.future_closure_discriminator_not_execute: Cancel once during first-control execution and once during the next control; require the receipt to name the actual active run and independently account for its current session, lease and any holder, never a preceding run.

material_findings.title: Unresolved cancellation is repeated, invalidating the advertised cleanup reserve
material_findings.mechanism: run_bounded invokes cancel_active at a deadline and preserves ACTIVE_PID when UNRESOLVED is set, then the caller invokes finish 96, whose unconditional cancel_active sends another TERM and starts a fresh grace+40-second wait; no already-cancelled or already-unresolved guard prevents that second allowance. [Cancellation](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L49-L64) [Finish](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L88-L90) [Deadline and caller](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L104-L139)
material_findings.concrete_static_counterexample: Take the explicit exit-97 state the new code is designed to handle: the same launcher remains alive after the first wait; with live-step grace 6, the route waits 46 seconds, records UNRESOLVED, returns, then waits another 46 seconds in finish before scanning/probing, already exceeding the entire 70-second cleanup reserve. [Reserve](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L29-L35) [Two invocations](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L88-L113) [Live-step settings and finish](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L117-L139)
material_findings.consequence: The stated one-TERM policy and 66-second cancellation calculation do not describe this reachable source path; 600 seconds is not established as the requested aggregate bound merely by summing 597, although this does not predict that the ordinary fast controls will exceed 600 seconds. [Request](../../s4-v5/SLOT_REQUEST_V5.md#L77-L79) [One-TERM claim](../../s4-v5/SLOT_REQUEST_V5.md#L133-L134)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Make cancellation idempotent with one recorded absolute cancellation deadline, do not restart the allowance in finish, and reconcile elapsed startup/finalization costs with the admission calculation.
material_findings.future_closure_discriminator_not_execute: A bounded private cancellation discriminator must exercise the unresolved return-to-finish path, count one TERM request, retain exclusion/identity, and show no second full grace allowance; do not KILL the lease holder to force a timing pass.

material_findings.title: Holder-receipt failure intentionally destroys exclusion while survivors remain unverified
material_findings.owner: Canonical S4 execution-layer builder; parent for any required ownership rescope
material_findings.mechanism: On verified-holder receipt write/rename failure, the code kills the token-matching holder, marks LEASE_RELEASED_AT_EXIT=true and exits through QUARANTINE_HOLDER_FAILED 10, without verifying survivors gone or transferring exclusion to another checked owner. [Failure branch](../../s4-v5/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v5.sh#L185-L205)
material_findings.concrete_static_counterexample: Start at the specifically supported quarantine state SURVIVORS nonempty, with the runner already exited and the new holder alive with the inherited lease; let QUARANTINE_LEASE_HOLDER.tmp creation fail with ENOSPC, or its rename fail with a normal filesystem error: lines 194-205 deliberately kill that working holder and close the launcher's own fd on exit while the prior step descendants have fd 9 closed. [Handoff failure](../../s4-v5/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v5.sh#L186-L205) [Survivor entry](../../s4-v5/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v5.sh#L220-L225) [Step fd closure](../../s4-v5/runner/s4-r6-lib-v5.sh#L107-L108)
material_findings.consequence: Exit 10 is more honest than a false retained-lease claim, but an UNSAFE RELEASE label is not the mandated unresolved-survivor exclusion; the same storage failure can also prevent the promised supervisor receipt, so reporting is not a substitute for containment. [Publication](../../s4-v5/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v5.sh#L99-L120) [Contract](../../../OP88_WAVE1.md#L130-L133)
material_findings.scope_qualification: No normal Stage 1 scenario intentionally exercises this failure and all common predicates require no quarantine; this is the existing shared exceptional-path obligation, not a claim that a current private control has produced survivors or a demand for safety under arbitrary kernel failure. [Common predicates](../../s4-v5/controls/control-predicates-v5.py#L62-L78)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Do not destroy the last verified exclusion holder before survivors are verified gone or a checked recovery owner has accepted them; if bounded caller completion and durable recovery on receipt failure need a different ownership contract, request parent rescope rather than declaring intentional release closed.
material_findings.future_closure_discriminator_not_execute: Under a separately authorized private-only fixture, discriminate holder-creation and receipt-publication failure with a known unresolved session; require containment plus attributable recovery or an explicit approved narrower boundary, not only nonzero status.

material_findings.title: An otherwise perfect Stage 1 cannot emit its mandatory success receipt
material_findings.mechanism: The request requires driver 0, passing predicates and an EXIT code=0 terminal line, but only finish emits EXIT code=; the successful path prints ALL 8 CONTROLS OK and executes bare exit 0 with no EXIT trap or finish call. [Pass definition](../../s4-v5/SLOT_REQUEST_V5.md#L94-L95) [Only EXIT logger](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L87-L100) [Success path](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L150-L159)
material_findings.concrete_static_counterexample: Let every predicate pass, all sessions be empty, the private lease be free and the direct refusal be exactly 71: line 159 exits zero without the required EXIT code=0 receipt, so the packet's own anything-else STOP rule still rejects the run. [Terminal path](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L150-L159) [Request](../../s4-v5/SLOT_REQUEST_V5.md#L94-L95)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Route success through the intended checked finalization/receipt path, preserving the successful code only when its final facts are confirmed, and reconcile the acceptance text with actual emitted evidence.
material_findings.future_closure_discriminator_not_execute: A successful exact control run must produce one terminal success receipt with current final lease/session facts and the raw outer exit 0.

material_findings.title: The new bounded session scan converts timeout/error into verified-empty evidence
material_findings.mechanism: session_state assigns the stdout of timeout pgrep piped to tr but never saves the timeout/pgrep status; without pipefail, an empty scan timeout or pgrep error leaves LEFT_INITIAL/LEFT_FINAL empty just like no matches, then a successful lease probe permits the normal success branch. [Scan](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L69-L85) [Decision](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L141-L148)
material_findings.concrete_static_counterexample: For otherwise expected receipts, let the explicitly bounded pgrep phase expire before printing a PID: tr produces empty output, session_state returns 0, LEFT_INITIAL is empty, and LEASE_FREE=true causes line 148 not to stop; the source therefore accepts an uncompleted independent census, without needing a claim that a real survivor was observed. [Timeout pipeline](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L75-L85) [Acceptance](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L143-L148)
material_findings.consequence: The control cannot establish its asserted independent empty-session fact when that very bounded phase times out or errors, and the same suppression can hide the observation needed to select unsafe-release exit 98. [Finish classification](../../s4-v5/controls/run-controls-v5.sh#L91-L96)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Capture census stdout and raw status separately; accept only the defined successful/no-match outcomes, and preserve timed-out/error/unknown as a stopping, nonempty-or-unknown ownership state rather than empty.
material_findings.future_closure_discriminator_not_execute: A data/adapter-level private negative control should make the scan return no output with a timeout/error status and require a non-success unknown-census receipt, distinct from an actual successful no-match scan.
